# Fixture provenance

All fixtures are independently authored from accepted public requirements and
permanent catalog content. None was emitted by a product materializer, hasher,
loader, validator or plan encoder.

| Fixture | Source and expected fact |
| -- | -- |
| relations.tsv | ADR0410 and the complete59rows of docs/reference/catalog-preparation-relations.md; explicit common guide, sorted guide unions and both permanent-instance reasons for every current section source |
| unions.json | Same reference's common-guide, sharing, documentation, conditional-welcome and deliberate deploy-direction paragraphs; literal mixed-case unions and surviving causes |
| all-guidance.tsv | Independent literal nineteen-guide union and every exact cause for the first permanent ID of all59source rows; no runtime expected-union calculation |
| repository.body.txt | Exact unresolved Body in contracts/catalog/reader/content/sections/repository-access.yaml, including its final LF |
| repository-a.canonical | Hand-transcribed repository-access definition after assigning repo-a, under contracts/section/hasher/contract.md field/default/prose rules; no final LF belongs to canonical text |
| repository-b.canonical | Same derivation for permanent repo-b; original catalog ID stays only in Source.Template after hashing |
| Inline diagnostic cases | ADR0110 no-winner rule, ADR0120 no-default rule, ADR0410 ownership/carrier/profile, own table and exact dependency problem codes in their public contracts |
| Inline plan/value/directory controls | model types, ADR0030 self-contained unresolved plan, authoringvalidator and validator contracts; no expected result derives from a runtime validator |
| Inline cap boundaries | Proposed finite caller-admission table in this draft; positive256 repeats are constructible;8192bindings only isolates early charging before later duplicate-name error and is not asserted as a valid complete request |

Guide Markdown expectations read the permanent normative files under
contracts/catalog/reader/content/preparation directly. That is fixed authored
content, not product output or dynamically discovered expected relations.
The SHA256 standard primitive hashes only hand-authored canonical fixture bytes
in tests. Root must independently inspect those texts and compute/review the
primitive hashes before adoption. No product canonicalizer supplies them.
